blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: Ancient background for Mercy Theme includes covenant practice, worship, kingship, wisdom instruction, and prophetic critique; the entry ties that world to Exodus 34:6-7, Psalm 103:8-13, divine-mercy, and grace without letting comparison replace the biblical witness. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken.
